description: This file declares the interface for Slap Object Entity operations in the Service Logic Aggregation Plane (SLAP). It contains function prototypes for creating, removing, enrolling, and initializing the object, indicating its role as an API header for external use.

methods.name: SlapCreateObjEntity
methods.description: Creates a new SLAP Object Entity instance within the given context.

methods.name: SlapOeoCreate
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new instance of the SLAP Object Entity.

methods.name: SlapOeoRemove
methods.description: Removes and cleans up an existing SLAP Object Entity instance.

methods.name: SlapOeoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls contained objects or components within the SLAP Object Entity.

methods.name: SlapOeoInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the SLAP Object Entity instance.
